Class CachingConnectionFactoryConfigurer

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.boot.amqp.autoconfigure.AbstractConnectionFactoryConfigurer<org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.CachingConnectionFactory>
org.springframework.boot.amqp.autoconfigure.CachingConnectionFactoryConfigurer
public class CachingConnectionFactoryConfigurer extends AbstractConnectionFactoryConfigurer<org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.CachingConnectionFactory>
Configures Rabbit CachingConnectionFactory with sensible defaults tuned using configuration properties.

可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义自定义的`CachingConnectionFactory`，其配置基于自动配置所产生的配置。

Since:
4.0.0
Author:
Chris Bono, Moritz Halbritter, Andy Wilkinson, Phillip Webb
